input.quote: 10.1 On expiry or termination, Customer's right to access terminated subscription Services ends after any agreed transition period. Rights in accepted Deliverables, paid-up licences, Customer Data, and materials Customer owned or licensed independently continue according to their terms.
input.rationale: Section 10 (Effect of Expiry or Termination) addresses only cut-off of access, delivery of Deliverables and refunds. Nothing in the Agreement obliges Vendor to provide transition assistance or to return/export Customer Data on exit: Section 10.1 merely references "any agreed transition period" without creating an obligation, Section 16.5 covers Confidential Information and expressly carves Customer Data out to "Sections 11 and 15" (Section 11 does not exist, and Section 15 contains only processing-purpose and privacy-compliance terms with no return, export or deletion duty). In a hosted-services agreement this is a material gap and risks the walk-away outcome of no data return. We therefore insert a new Section 10.3 tracking the preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a commonly used machine-readable format within thirty days, and certified deletion thereafter (with the customary backup/legal-retention carve-out already accepted in Section 16.5). Fallback of ninety days' assistance is offered in the comment.

ops.text: 10.3 Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty days of Customer's request, return or make available for download all Customer Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems, subject to routine backups and legal retention requirements, and certify such deletion in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 10 ends Customer's access but says nothing about getting our data back or help migrating, so we have added a standard exit clause: up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and certified deletion afterwards. If six months is an issue, we can accept ninety days of assistance provided the thirty-day data export and deletion certificate remain.
proposal.summary: Insert Section 10.3 requiring post-termination transition assistance, machine-readable return of Customer Data within 30 days, and certified deletion.
